overall: The AG found the Board and Commission did not violate the Open Meeting Law as alleged over a Commission matter raised off-notice at the March 11 Board meeting; the minutes request was declined, with reminders only.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged a Commission-related matter not listed on the Board's March 11 notice was raised and briefly discussed at the meeting.
allegations.key_passage: After reviewing the video recording of the March 11 meeting and the responses from the Board and the Commission, it is clear that the Board had not anticipated that Ms. Candia would discuss the Commission during the March 11 meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged Commission members improperly deliberated during the Board's March 11 meeting on a topic not on the notice.
allegations.key_passage: Based on the facts before us, including the facts as alleged in the complaint, it is clear that a quorum of the Commission was not present at the March 11 meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint referenced a records request, including draft executive session minutes, about a complaint discussed in executive session on February 26.
allegations.key_passage: Because this portion of the complaint does not clearly allege a violation of the Open Meeting Law, we decline to address it.
